In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] '''battled''' a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in an abandoned building near the [[Zi-Zhinn Marketplace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
The Jedi Master was [[Death/Legends|mortally wounded]] by the stormtroopers, but a group of [[Whiplash]] dissidents led by [[Nick Rostu]] drove away the stormtroopers. Before Evel Piell died, he spoke to Rostu about a mission to find a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] named [[10-4TO]].
